leaves.name: n3-gap-core-and-four-worker-cpu-path
leaves.replaces: EngineCore, Scheduler requests and four CUDA workers during native and stock steps
leaves.implementation: The actual generated EngineCore.add_request AST over the pinned reference executes with a SimpleNamespace scheduler that records acceptance. test_e3_native_overlap.idle_stack/core_for executes the real control Future/transport/four worker adapters. test_e3_r4_worker_bridge.Stack executes the real controller/driver/bridge/dispatcher open and commit with CPU EventBus, fake torch events/streams/model/PP as in that fixture. Actual work envelopes, computed frontier and cache publication are identical with receipts off/on and a failed sink. No GPU operations execute.
leaves.equivalence: The hooks read the same request_id, num_prompt_tokens, engine epoch, route generation and real native transaction. The recorder never mutates these fields. Actual generated Core revert equality, typed control sequence and four-worker cache publication are checked.
leaves.cannot_prove: GPU ordering or timing, real mailbox/pipe backpressure and diagnostic overhead on the box; CPU event completions are manually supplied. The first API admission record precedes allocation of the native request_generation; request_key joins it to later real transaction identities.

leaves.name: n3-gap-policy-and-log-faults
leaves.replaces: The live AutoArmPolicy scheduler/cohort and receipt sink
leaves.implementation: test_compose5_declines.Stage(req()) supplies the declared FCFS scheduler/request/plan fields to the unpatched AutoArmPolicy selection/pause/drain. ed.emit_receipt_lines is captured, returns True or raises OSError. A driver._gap_event callback also raises OSError; work still advances. NativeProgress.GAP_LIMIT ( GAP_LIMIT ) is reduced to2 in the budget test, proving the production32768-event branch emits one coverage-incomplete marker then no more lines. A real os.pipe, real ReceiptWriter and real receipt_lines.check/verdict validate the new prefix, pid/seq/sha and unique gap_seq without mocking either allowlist.
leaves.equivalence: Actual selection and control branches execute; diagnostic failures cannot change the call or its final state. Production uses the same budget and formatter with a larger limit. The writer uses the same atomic-fifo path; no copied or hand-built receipt bypasses its prefix guard.
leaves.cannot_prove: The live plan/KV and pause durations; worker/GPU resource fit; production stderr/file throughput. Fields and event-query results in borrowed CPU rigs are fixtures, not device receipts.
